action.objective: Complete broad search over all legal moves at depth 4 to identify the strongest continuation while preserving the material advantage.
action.rationale: Position is materially dominant (Q,2R,B,2N vs b,k with pawns). Black king on e6 is exposed; many forcing options exist (Qg7-f6/g6 checks, Bxc7, Nf7, etc.). Must first complete a depth-4 broad search over all roots as required by phase=broad_search before narrowing to a candidate.
